core.name: PORT
core.description: Port the web UI listens on in the Docker image.

core.name: DATA_DIR
core.description: Where Termix keeps its database, keys, plugins and uploads. Mount a volume here. Outside Docker the default is ./db/data.

core.name: ALLOW_EMPTY_DATA_DIR
core.description: Start even when DATA_DIR is empty but an older data folder exists elsewhere. Only set this if you really want a fresh install.

core.name: PUID
core.description: User id the container runs as. Match it to the owner of your data volume.

core.name: PGID
core.description: Group id the container runs as.

core.name: BASE_PATH
core.description: Serve Termix under a sub path, like /termix. Set the same path in your reverse proxy.

core.name: NODE_ENV
core.description: Set by the image. Leave it alone.

core.name: VERSION
core.description: Set by the image to the Termix version. Leave it alone.

core.name: SETTINGS_CACHE_REFRESH_SECONDS
core.description: How often each server instance reloads admin settings from the database. 0 turns the refresh off.

core.name: SSH_AUTH_SOCK
core.description: SSH agent socket used for hosts set to agent auth when they do not name their own socket.

core.name: ENABLE_SSL
core.description: Serve HTTPS. Termix makes a self-signed certificate on first boot unless you give it one.

core.name: SSL_PORT
core.description: Port for HTTPS.

core.name: SSL_CERT_PATH
core.description: Certificate file for HTTPS.

core.name: SSL_KEY_PATH
core.description: Private key file for HTTPS.

core.name: SSL_DOMAIN
core.description: Domain put in the self-signed certificate.

core.name: DATABASE_DIALECT
core.description: sqlite, postgres or mysql.

core.name: DATABASE_URL
core.description: Connection URL for postgres or mysql, like postgres://user:pass@db:5432/termix.

core.name: DATABASE_POOL_MAX
core.description: Most connections Termix opens to postgres or mysql.

core.name: DATABASE_SSL
core.description: TLS for postgres or mysql: require, no-verify or disable.

core.name: DB_FILE_ENCRYPTION
core.description: Encrypt the SQLite file at rest. Set false only if something else already encrypts the disk.

core.name: DB_FILE_KEY
core.description: Only used to open SQLite files encrypted by very old versions. You almost never need it.

core.name: DATABASE_LAYER_SKIP_PREUPGRADE_BACKUP
core.description: Skip the backup Termix takes of the data folder before an upgrade changes the database.

core.name: DATABASE_LAYER_PREUPGRADE_BACKUP_KEEP
core.description: How many of those upgrade backups to keep.

core.name: JWT_SECRET
core.description: Signs sign-in sessions. At least 64 characters. Made for you and saved in DATA_DIR/.env if not set. Also read from JWT_SECRET_FILE.

core.name: DATABASE_KEY
core.description: Key for the encrypted SQLite file, 64 hex characters. Made for you if not set. Also read from DATABASE_KEY_FILE.

core.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
core.description: Wraps the data keys that encrypt passwords and SSH keys, 64 hex characters. Made for you if not set. Also read from ENCRYPTION_KEY_FILE.

core.name: INTERNAL_AUTH_TOKEN
core.description: Token the server uses to call itself. Made for you if not set. Also read from INTERNAL_AUTH_TOKEN_FILE.

core.name: TERMIX_REQUIRE_EXTERNAL_SECRETS
core.description: Refuse to start unless the four secrets above come from env vars or _FILE files, so none are written to disk.

core.name: OIDC_SYSTEM_SECRET
core.description: Only read to move data from installs older than 2.5. Never change it on an install that has it.

core.name: WEBAUTHN_SYSTEM_SECRET
core.description: Only read to move data from installs older than 2.5. Never change it on an install that has it.

core.name: ALLOW_PASSWORD_LOGIN
core.description: true or false. Overrides the admin setting for signing in with a username and password.

core.name: ALLOW_REGISTRATION
core.description: true or false. Overrides the admin setting for creating new accounts.

core.name: ALLOW_PASSWORD_RESET
core.description: true or false. Overrides the admin setting for resetting a password from the sign in page.

core.name: EXTERNAL_ALLOW_REGISTRATION
core.description: true or false. Overrides the admin setting for creating accounts the first time someone signs in with SSO or LDAP.

core.name: EXTERNAL_FORCE_HTTPS
core.description: Build sign in callback URLs with https even when the request came in over http. Use it behind a proxy that does not send X-Forwarded-Proto.

core.name: OIDC_ALLOW_REGISTRATION
core.description: Old name for EXTERNAL_ALLOW_REGISTRATION. Still read in 26.10.

core.name: OIDC_FORCE_HTTPS
core.description: Old name for EXTERNAL_FORCE_HTTPS. Still read in 26.10.

core.name: TRUSTED_PROXY_AUTH_ENABLED
core.description: Let a proxy like Authelia or Authentik sign people in by sending their username in a header.

core.name: TRUSTED_PROXY_AUTH_TRUSTED_PROXIES
core.description: Comma separated IPs or CIDRs of the proxies allowed to send the headers. Required when trusted proxy login is on.

core.name: TRUSTED_PROXY_AUTH_USERNAME_HEADER
core.description: Header that holds the username.

core.name: TRUSTED_PROXY_AUTH_ROLE_HEADER
core.description: Header that holds the user's groups or roles.

core.name: TRUSTED_PROXY_AUTH_ROLE_MAP
core.description: JSON map from proxy roles to Termix roles, like {"admins":["admin"],"staff":["user"]}. Required when trusted proxy login is on.

core.name: TRUSTED_PROXIES
core.description: Comma separated IPs or CIDRs nginx takes the client IP from (X-Forwarded-For). Set it to your reverse proxy.

core.name: CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
core.description: Comma separated extra origins allowed to call the API from a browser.

core.name: TERMIX_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
core.description: Comma separated extra origins allowed to open WebSockets.

core.name: HTTP_PROXY
core.description: Proxy for outbound HTTP requests, like registry downloads and webhooks.

core.name: HTTPS_PROXY
core.description: Proxy for outbound HTTPS requests.

core.name: NO_PROXY
core.description: Comma separated hosts that skip the proxy.

core.name: LOG_LEVEL
core.description: debug, info, warn or error.

core.name: LOG_TIMESTAMP_FORMAT
core.description: iso or 24h. Unset uses the local time format.

core.name: AUDIT_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS
core.description: Delete audit entries older than this many days. Unset keeps them until the entry cap.

core.name: AUDIT_LOG_MAX_ENTRIES
core.description: Most audit entries kept. The oldest go first.

core.name: AUDIT_LOG_FORWARD_URL
core.description: Also POST every audit entry as JSON to this URL. Overrides the admin setting.

core.name: AUDIT_LOG_FORWARD_TOKEN
core.description: Bearer token sent with forwarded audit entries.

core.name: SESSION_RECORDING_RETENTION_DAYS
core.description: Only read once to carry a 2.8 value into the session-recording plugin.

core.name: TERMIX_PLUGIN_REGISTRY_URL
core.description: Use another plugin index instead of the official registry.

core.name: TERMIX_PLUGIN_STATS_URL
core.description: Where install counts are read from. Defaults to stats.json next to the registry index.

core.name: TERMIX_REQUIRE_SIGNED_PLUGINS
core.description: Only load plugins signed by a trusted key. Blocks uploads of unsigned files even in developer mode.

core.name: TERMIX_BUNDLED_PLUGINS_DIR
core.description: Where the plugins shipped with Termix are read from. Set by the image.

core.name: TERMIX_PLUGIN_PUBLIC_RATE_LIMIT
core.description: Requests per minute one IP may make to a plugin's public routes.

core.name: PLUGIN_MAX_KV_KEYS
core.description: Most key value entries one plugin may store.

core.name: ENABLE_INSECURE_MODE
core.description: Desktop app only. Skip TLS certificate checks for the linked server. Only for testing.

core.name: ELECTRON_DISABLE_GPU
core.description: Desktop app only. Set to 1 to turn off GPU acceleration if the window is blank or flickers.

core.name: TERMIX_LOCAL_SHELL
core.description: Desktop app only. Shell the local terminal opens, like /bin/zsh or pwsh.exe.

vars.name: OPKSSH_VERSION
vars.description: Use another opkssh release than the one Termix pins. Needs OPKSSH_SHA256 too.

vars.name: OPKSSH_SHA256
vars.description: SHA-256 of the opkssh binary for OPKSSH_VERSION. OPKSSH_SHA256_AMD64 and OPKSSH_SHA256_ARM64 set it per CPU.

vars.name: OPKSSH_SHA256_AMD64
vars.description: SHA-256 of the x64 binary for OPKSSH_VERSION.

vars.name: OPKSSH_SHA256_ARM64
vars.description: SHA-256 of the ARM64 binary for OPKSSH_VERSION.

vars.name: OPKSSH_BUNDLED_DIR
vars.description: Folder with a copy of opkssh baked into the image, used before downloading.

vars.name: GUACD_HOST
vars.description: Host guacd listens on. Overrides the guacd URL setting.

vars.name: GUACD_PORT
vars.description: Port guacd listens on.

vars.name: GUACD_URL
vars.description: guacd as host:port, in place of GUACD_HOST and GUACD_PORT.

vars.name: GUACD_TUNNEL_HOST
vars.description: Address guacd uses to reach Termix for hosts behind jump hosts. In Compose, the Termix container name.

vars.name: GUACD_RECORDING_PATH
vars.description: Folder guacd writes recordings to, as guacd sees it.

vars.name: GUACD_RECORDING_BACKEND_PATH
vars.description: The same folder as Termix sees it.

vars.name: GUACD_DRIVE_PATH
vars.description: Folder guacd keeps RDP drive files in. Each user gets a folder under it.

vars.name: GUACAMOLE_ENCRYPTION_KEY
vars.description: Key that encrypts connection tokens, 64 hex characters. Made for you on each start if not set. Set it when you run more than one Termix server.

vars.name: REDIS_URL
vars.description: Redis that several Termix servers share for meeting rooms, like redis://redis:6379. Not needed with one server.

vars.name: TERMIX_REDIS_PREFIX
vars.description: Prefix for the keys it writes in Redis.

vars.name: OIDC_CLIENT_ID
vars.description: Client ID of an OIDC provider set from the environment. Needs the next four too.

vars.name: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
vars.description: Its client secret.

vars.name: OIDC_ISSUER_URL
vars.description: Its issuer URL.

vars.name: OIDC_AUTHORIZATION_URL
vars.description: Its authorization endpoint.

vars.name: OIDC_TOKEN_URL
vars.description: Its token endpoint.

vars.name: OIDC_USERINFO_URL
vars.description: Its userinfo endpoint, if it is not the usual one.

vars.name: OIDC_IDENTIFIER_PATH
vars.description: Claim that identifies a user.

vars.name: OIDC_NAME_PATH
vars.description: Claim with the display name.

vars.name: OIDC_SCOPES
vars.description: Scopes to ask for.

vars.name: OIDC_ALLOWED_USERS
vars.description: Emails allowed to sign in, comma separated. Empty allows everyone.

vars.name: OIDC_ADMIN_GROUP
vars.description: Members of this group are admins.

vars.name: OIDC_GROUP_CLAIM
vars.description: Claim with the groups, if not groups, roles or group.

vars.name: OIDC_ROLE_MAP
vars.description: Groups to Termix roles as group:role pairs, comma separated. Works for every OIDC provider, not just this one.

vars.name: OIDC_ENV_OVERRIDE
vars.description: true makes the provider above the only one, even when providers are set up in the app.

vars.name: OIDC_SILENT_LOGIN_DEFAULT
vars.description: true or false. Sends visitors straight to SSO, and locks the setting.

vars.name: SNIPPET_EXECUTION_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
vars.description: Stop a snippet run on hosts after this many seconds. Unset means no limit.

vars.name: TERMIX_IMAGE_STORAGE_MODE
vars.description: Where pasted terminal images go: auto, local or remote. Only used until an admin saves the setting.

vars.name: TERMIX_IMAGE_DIR
vars.description: Folder on the Termix server for local image storage.

vars.name: TERMIX_IMAGE_HOST_PATH
vars.description: The same folder as the host sees it, for agents that read images.

vars.name: TERMIX_IMAGE_TTL_MS
vars.description: How long an image is kept, in milliseconds.

vars.name: TERMIX_MAX_IMAGE_COUNT
vars.description: Most images kept at once.

vars.name: TERMIX_MAX_IMAGE_STORAGE_BYTES
vars.description: Most bytes of images kept at once.

vars.name: REDIS_URL
vars.description: Redis that several Termix servers share for sign in state. Not needed with one server.

vars.name: TERMIX_STEP_CA_REDIS_PREFIX
vars.description: Prefix for the keys it writes in Redis.

vars.name: ENABLE_TELEMETRY
vars.description: true or false. Turns usage statistics on or off and locks the setting.

vars.name: POSTHOG_API_KEY
vars.description: Send reports to your own PostHog project instead of the Termix one.

vars.name: POSTHOG_HOST
vars.description: PostHog server to send to.
